meta.decision_rationale: Prototypes translate the preferred and wild-card scenarios into concrete services, each passed through the ethical gate before adoption.
tradeoffs: Federation increases interoperability but reduces unilateral control

prototypes.description: A community-governed programming calendar where patrons propose and vote on events and acquisitions.
prototypes.role_in_future: Anchors the library as an active civic hub with formalized community input.

losers: Staff who preferred informal, faster decisions

ethical_gate.question_1_value_violation_rationale: No radical value is violated; community voice and equity are strengthened.
ethical_gate.question_2_harmful_practice_rationale: No harmful practice: voting is transparent and open to all patrons.
ethical_gate.question_3_unacceptable_dependency_ratio: No unacceptable dependency; the tool is open-source and self-hosted.

prototypes.description: A federated catalog letting peer libraries share holdings and governance patterns while retaining local autonomy.
prototypes.role_in_future: Positions the library as a node in a community-controlled information network.

ethical_gate.question_1_value_violation_rationale: No value violated, but data-sharing terms across libraries need review.
ethical_gate.question_2_harmful_practice_rationale: No harmful practice, provided patron data is not shared across nodes.
ethical_gate.question_3_unacceptable_dependency_ratio: Held pending confirmation that no single node can control others' collections.
